Configure the layout of the Folder pane, message list pane, and message pane according to your preference.

{|
|[[Image:classicview]]||In '''Classic view''', the folder pane runs the entire height of the window.
|-
|[[Image:wideview]]||In '''Wide view''', the message pane spans across the width of both the folder pane and the message list pane.
|-
|[[Image:verticalview]]||In '''Vertical view''', all three panes are side-by-side.
|}

= How to change the layout =
Click the menu button [[T:appmenu TB]], open the {menu View} menu, then go to {menu Layout} and choose a layout.
